title: Error clinic (our own sentences)
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: error clinic (our own sentences))
intro: Lesson 34: Repair: the ten most common grammar errors. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Rule summary
points: كَانَ → khabar mansub; إِنَّ → ism mansub
3 to 10 opposite gender + plural; 11+ singular mansub

blocks.h: Error clinic: correct twenty sentences (TGA's own) and name the rule

questions.a: المَدَارِسُ كَبِيرَةٌ (Non-human plural: feminine singular adjective)
الأَشْجَارُ طَوِيلَةٌ (Non-human plural: feminine singular adjective)
أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ (أَنْ + verb: mansub (fathah))
يَجِبُ أَنْ نُسَاعِدَ الفُقَرَاءَ (أَنْ + verb: mansub)
لَنْ نَذْهَبَ (لَنْ + verb: mansub)
كَانَ الاِمْتِحَانُ سَهْلًا (كَانَ: khabar mansub)
كَانَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ طَوِيلَةً (كَانَ: khabar mansub)
لَمْ أَفْهَمِ السُّؤَالَ (لَمْ + verb: majzum (kasrah before ال))
لَمْ نَسْمَعِ الأَخْبَارَ (لَمْ + verb: majzum)
ثَلَاثُ سَيَّارَاتٍ (3 to 10: opposite gender to the singular noun)
خَمْسَةُ كُتُبٍ (3 to 10: opposite gender to the singular noun)
ثَلَاثُونَ مُعَلِّمًا (11 and above: singular noun, mansub)
هٰذِهِ مَدْرَسَةٌ (Feminine noun: هٰذِهِ)
هٰذَا كِتَابٌ (Masculine noun: هٰذَا)
ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى السُّوقِ (After a preposition: majrur)
جَلَسْنَا فِي الحَدِيقَةِ (After a preposition: majrur)
إِنَّ العِلْمَ نُورٌ (إِنَّ: its noun is mansub)
إِنَّ المُعَلِّمَةَ لَطِيفَةٌ (إِنَّ: its noun is mansub)
سَيَّارَةُ أَبِي الجَدِيدَةُ (Iḍāfah: no ال on the first noun; the adjective comes after)
كِتَابُ أُخْتِي المُفِيدُ (Iḍāfah: no ال on the first noun; the adjective comes after)

blocks.h: One correct sentence for each rule

questions.a: السَّيَّارَاتُ سَرِيعَةٌ: non-human plural takes feminine singular.
